description:
Maintainer asked (2026-08-13, before active hours): how does one make an AppImage from here?

Scope for the next active window:
- Identify which binary/binaries are the AppImage candidates. The only windowing-GUI crate is outram-park-digital-twin-engine (egui/eframe); terminal binaries (kovan-cli, kovan-tui, outram-foam-cli) are also candidates but benefit less from AppImage packaging.
- Check whether any packaging tooling already exists in the workspace before writing anything (HARD RULE: search the workspace first) - grep for AppImage/AppDir/linuxdeploy/appimagetool in scripts/, docs/, .github/.
- Then work out the concrete recipe (AppDir layout, .desktop file, icon, linuxdeploy vs appimagetool, GPL-3.0 bundling implications for shipped shared libs) and write it up in docs/.
